dialogue.text: I thought I'd never see that ginger kid again after that thing... I did. W-were you working with him? Was all of this a set up to distract me??
dialogue.name: Stephanie

dialogue.text: You know what, don't answer that. You have 5 seconds to tell me why I shouldn't kill you right here, right now.
dialogue.name: Stephanie

dialogue.text: Ohhhhh you're bold, huh? Ohhh okayyy... I see you like danger... I like that.
dialogue.name: Stephanie

dialogue.text: I don't know why you're fighting me, you can seriously be along aside me. It's a shame really; we would've worked out together but you're such a pain in the ass. oh well.
dialogue.name: Stephanie

dialogue.text: What do you mean you're not scared of me? Okay, spit it out. Are you like... a hired killer or have a death wish or something? Actually, I don't care... you're dying right now!
dialogue.name: Stephanie

dialogue.text: AHAHA! How do you like that, huh? Am I too hot for you??
dialogue.name: Stephanie

dialogue.text: Awww look at those little fingers... that poor skin, peeling off and bubbling! AHAHA!
dialogue.name: Stephanie

dialogue.text: Oh you piece of shit, you take that back! You think you can get outta this alive? Not this-
dialogue.name: Stephanie

dialogue.text: Oough... my fucking stomach... HEY! Where are you going, bitch!? Don't run from me! I. WILL. KILL. YOU!
dialogue.name: Stephanie
